name: Chromium
description: Web browser, for headless page checks and screenshots. Large.

verified.notes: Built by ezbx build from the Debian snapshot of the box's base image (20261104T212339Z) and used as the agent user with every capability dropped, no-new-privileges and no network: chromium 156.0.8078.79-1~deb12u1. Headless, it rendered a page (--dump-dom) and took a 200x100 screenshot. It needs --no-sandbox: its own sandbox needs kernel features the box drops on purpose (Debian's fix, chromium-sandbox, is a setuid helper, and the image removes setuid bits). The box is the sandbox.
